api.custom_appendix_off: The appendix Custom Ranges and Goals is available only while the optional feature Custom ranges and goals is on (Settings > Devices & services > GlucoCraft > Configure > Optional features).

config_flow.panel_address.none: no wall-panel address has been created. The box *Create a new wall-panel address* below creates it; it is needed before the first wall panel is built, because the build needs its id. Only the wall panels use it.
config_flow.panel_address.set: the address of the wall panels' data is `http://<Home Assistant address>/api/webhook/{webhook_id}?file=backfill` (and `?file=delta`). Its id, `{webhook_id}`, goes into the panel's secrets.yaml. The address is read-only and answers only on the home network; it is protected by its id and by Home Assistant's check that a request comes from the local network. This check works only when Home Assistant sees each panel's own network address; behind a reverse proxy, the proxy and Home Assistant must be set up to pass it on. The panels download their data from this address over plain HTTP, which is not encrypted: other devices on the same network could read the data or, by posing as Home Assistant, send false data to a panel; the panels' downloaded data are therefore only as private as the home network. After a log, backup or screenshot containing the address was shared, a new address can be created below.
config_flow.ranges.source_changed: The glucose source or its sensor limit was changed: the ranges below no longer fit the sensor's limits. The source and the ranges are saved together once the ranges fit.
config_flow.unit_not_read: GlucoCraft could not read the unit of the glucose source (it showed no value or no glucose unit), so the display unit starts as mg/dL. Check the display unit below.

The square card matches square panels, such as the 480 × 480 example panel; the rectangular card matches 800 × 480 panels and is close to rectangular panels of other sizes, such as the 1024 × 600 and 480 × 320 example panels. A card that does not match a panel shows the same information in a different layout.
